---
title: "New York Weather Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
```

```{r}
data("ny_noaa")

weather_data =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10
  ) |>
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2010) |>
  drop_na(tmax, tmin)
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Temperature Trends

```{r}
weather_data |>
  mutate(month_date = lubridate::floor_date(date, unit = "month")) |>
  group_by(month_date) |>
  summarize(mean_tmax = mean(tmax)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~month_date, y = ~mean_tmax, type = "scatter", mode = "lines") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Mean maximum temperature (°C)"))
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Temperature Distribution

```{r}
set.seed(1)

weather_data |>
  sample_n(5000) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~month, y = ~tmax, color = ~month, type = "box", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)"),
    showlegend = FALSE)
```

### Minimum vs. Maximum Temperature

```{r}
set.seed(1)

weather_data |>
  sample_n(5000) |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Date: ", date, "\nMin: ", tmin, "°C\nMax: ", tmax, "°C")) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~month, colors = "viridis", text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)"))
```
